entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary:
Erica Amon (Deputy Chair, Special Olympics NZ), Belinda Edwards (CEO, Basketball NZ) and Matthew Cooper (CEO, Sport Waikato). Facilitated by Gregor Fountain, Sport NZ.
This session shares how organisations are leading through change and complexity. It looks at alignment as a core leadership capability, with examples of decisions that improved coordination, clarity and outcomes.

Special Olympics NZ – Erica Amon, Board Deputy Chair and governance lead, will share the steps taken to lift governance performance, how mandate was strengthened, and the early impacts now being seen. 

Basketball NZ – Belinda Edwards, CEO will share Basketball NZ’s journey to align a complex national system, a transformation still actively being implemented.  She will outline the key leadership decisions behind the shift from a fragmented model to one built on clarity, alignment and accountability.  

Sport Waikato – Matthew Cooper, CEO will share the impacts realised three years on from Sport Waikato’s strategic decision to ‘lift up’—what they held onto, what they changed, and what impact looks like now.
